content: The title of Section 6 has been revised to Glycemic Goals and Hypoglycemia, and all information pertaining to hypoglycemia within the Standards of Care has been consolidated into this section. Recommendation 6.1 has been updated to emphasize the need for more frequent glycemic assessments in populations that require closer monitoring. The subsection on A1C Glycemic Assessment has been revised to incorporate recent evidence regarding the strengths and limitations of A1C testing. Additionally, serum glycated protein assays have been introduced as alternative methods to A1C for glycemic evaluation. Table 6.2 has been updated to include recommendations for the use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) and specific glycemic targets. Sections discussing glucose-lowering treatments have been revised to reflect findings from long-term studies that demonstrate the benefits of newer diabetes medications on microvascular and cardiovascular outcomes. Recommendations 6.8a and 6.8b have been added to provide guidance on situations where it may be appropriate to deintensify diabetes medications. Recommendations 6.11a, 6.11b, and 6.11c have been introduced to assist healthcare providers in evaluating a patient’s history of hypoglycemia, their awareness of hypoglycemia, and their risk of experiencing hypoglycemia.
